move: dashboard builds: counters, bars grow, line draws, rows slide; unbuilds
how: A light dashboard card rises in (y 40, scale .97, power3.out). Three stat tiles stagger up and their numbers count to $128,430 / $42,910 / 8,412 with expo.out over 1.6s; twelve bars grow from scaleY 0 with a 0.05s expo.out stagger from 9%, a black trend line draws over them with DrawSVG power2.inOut from 18-42%, and a tooltip pops onto the highlighted bar with back.out(2) at 40%. Transaction rows slide in from x 40 (0.09s stagger) and the app floats y -4 and back. From 83% the line undraws to its end, bars collapse right-to-left, rows exit, counters run back to 0 and the card drops out at 92%.
adapt: Replace stat values, bar heights (data-h), the SVG line path, months, transactions and the accent blue; keep the 1.6s expo.out count, 0.05s bar stagger and the 1.2s line draw.
port: mount(el, shot) renders the app from shot.stats/shot.bars/shot.transactions and sets bar heights and tooltip position; animate returns the timeline with build 0-0.42D, float, and unbuild from 0.83D. Register DrawSVG; scope the counter querySelectors to el.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false when composed
tooltip position is computed from the highlighted bar index, keep it in sync with the data
